author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork.

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: Eden Garden Jewelry
title: We need an illustrator
content:
We need an illustrator. We can’t tell you why. Not yet

You’re the one if:
▪️ you design original characters, from first sketch to final art
▪️ you can do turnarounds, expression sheets and pose variations
▪️ anatomy is your strength
▪️ fantasy, flora, fauna and hybrid creatures feel like home
▪️ you draw bodies and skin tones of every kind
▪️ your work is hand-made, digital or traditional
▪️ you’re free in October 2026

It’s a bonus if you animate, tell stories in panels, or love Art Nouveau and folklore.
Paid commission. Your style. Your name on every post. NDA until launch.

To apply, email smm@edengardenjewelry.com or DM with your portfolio, 3 characters you love, and the creature you’ve always wanted to draw
